documentTitle: Pursuit Arena — USI Pursuits COE · 10 Years

start.title: Pursuit Arena
start.keyboard: Keyboard: W A S D or arrows to drive, Shift to boost, Enter to open a station, Esc for the menu.
start.touch: Touch: point the joystick where you want to go; tap ↵ to open a station.
start.sound: Starting turns the sound on. Press M to mute.

menu.title: Menu
menu.graphicsIntro: Lower settings run faster on older laptops and phones.
menu.lowNote: No bloom, lighter effects, simpler distant buildings
menu.resetIntro: This wipes your stamps, badges, XP, collectibles and records on this device. It cannot be undone.

credits.title: Credits
credits.intro: Pursuit Arena celebrates 10 years of the Deloitte USI Pursuits COE.
credits.team: Team credits to be supplied by the USI Pursuits COE team.
credits.software: Built with three.js (MIT), Rapier physics (Apache-2.0) and Vite (MIT).
credits.reference: Driving feel and camera inspired by Bruno Simon's 2019 folio (MIT), reimplemented from scratch.
credits.audio: All sounds and music are synthesised placeholders until the final audio is supplied.

hud.hintDrive: W A S D or arrow keys to drive · Shift boost · Space brake
hud.hintTouch: Point the joystick where you want to go
hud.hintFindStation: Drive into a glowing square to open a station

explore.title: Explore the arena
explore.intro: Choose a place to fly there and open it. You can keep driving at any time.
